summary.headline: US forces global shutdown of Fable 5; Gatekeeper slumps
summary.body: Days after launch, the US government issued an emergency export-control directive barring foreign nationals from using Claude Fable 5 and Mythos 5 over a reported jailbreak. Anthropic disabled both models for all customers worldwide and disputed the basis. A unilateral, sudden clampdown hurts Global Coordination, which drags down Gatekeeper and lifts Self-Destruction; pulling frontier models also slows Capability Velocity, which raises Reversion. The same day, SpaceX, which absorbed xAI, listed on Nasdaq at about $1.75T in the largest IPO ever, a jump in Power Concentration that weighs on Libertarian Utopia. Security worries added up: CISA cut federal patch windows to three days because AI speeds up attacks, and researchers showed 'agentjacking' of coding agents. Horizon Balance fell 0.44 to 1.8.
summary.movers_note: Gatekeeper -1.5, from the Fable 5 shutdown directive (-1.47); Self-Destruction +0.9, from the directive (+0.76) and CISA's patch order (+0.16); Libertarian Utopia -0.6, mostly from the SpaceX IPO (-0.48).

events.title: US export-control directive forces Anthropic to suspend Fable 5 and Mythos 5 worldwide
events.summary: Days after launch, the US government issued an emergency export-control directive barring foreign nationals from accessing Fable 5 and Mythos 5 over a reported jailbreak; Anthropic disabled both models for all customers globally and disputed the basis.
events.reason: First government-forced withdrawal of a deployed frontier model, via unilateral national-security export control. Skeptic pass: T2-T3; kept T3 (within one tier).

events.title: SpaceX, owner of xAI, lists on Nasdaq at ~$1.75T
events.summary: SpaceX, which absorbed xAI as SpaceXAI, began trading as SPCX after a $135/share IPO raising ~$75B, the largest ever, and closed up ~25% on day one.
events.reason: Massive capital to an AI/compute conglomerate with large lab compute contracts.

events.title: CISA cuts federal patch window to three days citing AI-driven attacks
events.summary: CISA ordered agencies to patch the most serious flaws within three days because AI is speeding up exploitation.
events.reason: Official recognition of AI-accelerated cyber threat.

events.title: 'Agentjacking' attack tricks AI coding agents into running malicious code
events.summary: Researchers showed fake Sentry error reports with markdown injection could hijack agents like Claude Code and Cursor.

events.title: Japan revises government cybersecurity standards for AI-enabled attacks
events.summary: Japan's National Cyber Director's Office tightened incident reporting and MFA rules to counter AI-enabled cyberattacks.

events.title: Chinese humanoid robot makers race to IPO: EngineAI files in Hong Kong, Unitree seeks $7B
events.summary: Shenzhen's EngineAI filed confidentially for a Hong Kong IPO after starting T800 shipments, as Unitree and others pursue listings.
